description: Work out what a deal costs. Use when someone asks about fees or deposits. Returns the fee (1.5% of the job, max 50 USDC), buyer deposit, seller payout and Buyer Review bond. Example: amount_usdc '100', mode 'automatic', starter 'buyer' gives fee 1.50 and deposit 101.50. Read-only.

amount_usdc.description: Job amount in USDC, e.g. '100' or '12.5'. Automatic min 10, Buyer Review min 100.

buyer_address.description: Optional buyer address. If set, the fee is also checked against the contract.

mode.description: automatic: seller is paid unless the buyer objects in time. buyer_review: buyer approves, with a bond each side.

starter.description: Who starts the deal. The starter pays the fee.

name: quote_fee
title: Quote protocol fee
